## Review checklist

- [ ] I read the applicable `AGENTS.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md` rules.
- [ ] I checked `git status` before editing and preserved unrelated changes.
- [ ] I changed the canonical source rather than hand-editing generated output.
- [ ] I added or updated meaningful tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I checked unknown, ambiguous, malformed, and legacy inputs where relevant.
- [ ] I preserved user-owned files, hooks, configuration fields, and approval boundaries.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, hidden network calls, credentials, raw prompt persistence, or real user data.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` when the change is release-visible.
- [ ] I documented compatibility or migration impact for breaking changes.
- [ ] I confirmed that only intended files changed.
